# Local NPC Chat RPG
> An experimental static web app (v0.9.0-build.001): chat with residents you create (or four optional samples), powered by a small language model (LFM2.5 350M or 1.2B-JP, selectable) that runs locally in the browser via WebGPU. No server, no API key; conversations stay on the device.
URL: https://egoaid.github.io/Local-NPC-Chat/
© 2026 egoaid. All rights reserved (third-party components excluded; see README.md).
It also has group modes where residents improvise a story or play shiritori among themselves.
